name: Veselin Iliev
bio: Veselin moved to London 2 years ago to join the Android team at ASOS. An Android developer since Froyo (long long time ago), he’s current focus is combining RxJava, Kotlin and MVP / MVVM patterns to provide smooth and seamless user experiences. Passionate about testing and writing clean code in general. Loves to spend his free time cycling, skiing or listening to podcasts.
